gallery.emptyHint: A work is one picture or a series of up to 10 frames in one look.
gallery.removeAsk: Delete the work “{title}”? Its pictures stay in the media library.

grid.nothingToDraw: No frame can be drawn now: they are being drawn, have your own pictures or wait for the first frame.
grid.pilotReady: The first frame is ready. If you like it, accept it: the other frames will follow its look.
grid.pilotWait: This is a series: draw the first frame first. The other frames will follow its look.

frame.title: Frame {n}
frame.pilotHint: The other frames of the series follow the look of this one
frame.removeAsk: Delete frame {n}? Its pictures stay in the media library.

viewer.focusPlaceholder: What to look for, for example: cup, logo
viewer.pickHint: Click an object, or draw a box around the part you want to change.
viewer.drawHint: Draw a box around the part you want to change, or find the objects first.
viewer.editPart: What to change in this part
viewer.editWhole: What to change in the picture
viewer.editPlaceholder: For example: make the background blue
viewer.restoreHint: Make this version the current one. It is free.
viewer.ownSettingsHint: What you set here is for this frame only. The rest comes from the work.
viewer.attachmentsHint: Pictures for this frame only, for example a photo of the product.
viewer.feedbackPlaceholder: What to fix in this frame

settings.title: Name
settings.kitChanged: The kit was changed after this work took it.
settings.sizeFallback: This model cannot draw {size}: it uses the nearest size it has.
settings.seriesHint: Draw the first frame and accept it: the other frames then follow its look.
settings.ideasBriefHint: Used by the frames that have no description of their own
settings.referencesHint: Examples of the look you want. The model takes the mood and style from them.
settings.noSubjects: No subjects yet. Add products, people or props on the Brand screen.
settings.styleWords: Describe the style in your own words
settings.styleSample: Also send the style's sample picture
settings.feedbackHint: What to fix next time, for example: less background, brighter colors
settings.blocksHint: The parts of the request to the model. Grey ones do not apply right now.
settings.framesDropAsk: Frames with a picture or a description will be deleted: {n}. Go on?

overlay.name: Text on top
overlay.hint: The model leaves room for the words; you put them on top later in the editor.

model.name: Model draws the text
model.hint: The model writes the words right in the picture. Letters can come out with mistakes.

picker.title: Choose pictures
picker.dropMany: Drop pictures here or click to choose (up to {max})
picker.dropOne: Drop a picture here or click to choose
picker.full: You can choose at most {max} pictures.

output_size.name: Exact size
output_size.hint: Tells the model the size of the picture in pixels.

language.name: Text language
language.hint: Asks the model to write the words in the app language.

brand_fonts.name: Brand fonts
brand_fonts.hint: Describes the kit fonts so the lettering looks alike.

tone_of_voice.name: Tone of voice
tone_of_voice.hint: Adds the kit tone of voice to set the mood.

logo.name: Logo
logo.hint: Sends the kit logo so the model can place it.

project_references.name: Reference pictures
project_references.hint: Sends the reference pictures of the work as examples of the look.

task_attachments.name: Frame attachments
task_attachments.hint: Sends the pictures attached to this frame.

subjects.name: Subjects
subjects.hint: Sends photos and descriptions of the chosen products, people or props.

identity_assets.name: Brand elements
identity_assets.hint: Sends the kit elements: patterns, icons, mascots.

photo_style.name: Photo style
photo_style.hint: Adds the chosen photo style: light, camera, colors.

slide_position.name: Place in the series
slide_position.hint: Tells the model which frame of the series this is, so it does not draw numbers or arrows.

slide_text.name: Room for the text
slide_text.hint: Tells the model which words go on top later, so it leaves room for them.

draw_text.name: Draw the text
draw_text.hint: Asks the model to draw the words from the frame texts.

no_lettering.name: No letters
no_lettering.hint: Asks the model not to draw any letters or words.

quality.name: Quality
quality.hint: Asks for sharp focus and clean detail.

variant_diversity.name: New variant
variant_diversity.hint: On a redraw, asks for a different composition and angle.

feedback.name: Feedback
feedback.hint: Adds your notes on what to fix.

reasons.no_size: This picture has no exact size
reasons.large_size: 2K and 4K keep the model's own size
reasons.text_not_drawn: Only when the model draws the text
reasons.no_brand: The work has no brand kit
reasons.no_tone: The kit has no tone of voice
reasons.no_elements: The kit has no brand elements
reasons.single_frame: Only in a work with 2 or more frames
reasons.text_drawn: Off while the model draws the text

skip.pilot_not_ready: they wait for the first frame

errors.bad_image_type: Only PNG, JPEG and WebP pictures work here.
errors.bad_file: This picture is gone or is not a picture.
errors.frame_busy: The frame is being drawn. Wait or stop it first.
errors.frame_no_picture: The frame has no picture yet.
errors.pilot_not_ready: The first frame has no picture yet. Draw it first.
errors.too_many_frames: A work has from 1 to {max} frames.
errors.too_many_images: Too many pictures for this model. Remove some reference pictures or attachments.
errors.bad_text_mode: Unknown text mode. Reload the page.
errors.version_unknown: This version is gone: its picture was deleted.
errors.brief_required: Write what the picture should show.
errors.bad_style: This style is no longer in the library. Choose another one.
errors.no_kit: The work has no brand kit.
errors.last_frame: A work keeps at least one frame.
errors.bad_order: The frame order is out of date. Reload the page.
errors.model_wrong_kind: This model cannot draw pictures. Choose another one.
errors.nothing_to_export: No frame has a picture yet.
errors.stuck: The drawing showed no progress for too long and was stopped.
